parameters.note: Pre-integrated by analyses.trajectory.booster_burnout; burnout state fed forward
Stage-1 burnout -> stage-2 ignition handoff. Coast phase under drag + gravity (not yet integrated; placeholder). Ramjet inlet start and combustor ignition transient not modeled (TBD).

Ramjet cruise: quasi-steady design point (Mach 2.5, 10,000 m ISA), NOT a trajectory ODE (fuel depletion, drag and altitude/velocity coupling over time remain TBD). thrust_N/tsfc_kg_per_Ns/mdot_fuel_kg_s from analyses.propulsion.ramjet_cycle.RamjetCycleAnalysis (matched design nozzle); thrust_cylindrical_nozzle_N is the as-built Fusion CAD cylindrical-nozzle thrust, kept alongside thrust_N so the CAD-vs-design discrepancy stays visible. cruise_time_s = fuel_mass_kg / mdot_fuel_kg_s and cruise_range_m = V_cruise * cruise_time_s are DERIVED from the SZACOWANY 15 kg fuel_mass_kg. Reference model: L2 1-D cycle, single-method, MATLAB baseline unavailable, CFD delta +20-30% open (see ramjet_cycle module docstring 'REFERENCE-MODEL DISCLOSURE').
